search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| parse regex field=metrics "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| timeslice 5m
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues  by _timeslice
| outlier count_issues
| where count_issues_violation =1
